identification: Oil on canvas/board, 'Evening on the Yarra River', 35 x 25 cm (as catalogued), dusk river with dead trees, gilt frame with grey slip. Catalogued 'Ernest Chrismtas attributed' (typo). Unsigned in photo. Ernest William Christmas (1863-1918) landscapes are in the same tonalist manner but many similar dusk river scenes by other hands exist.
